_comment: Consolidated config for the proteome-scale batch pipeline (see ~/.claude/plans/i-m-considering-a-large-humble-sun.md). Absent entirely, every analysis resolves to its *_remote backend and the app's behavior is unchanged. Copy/edit this file to opt individual analyses into local/bulk backends once their reference data (see reference_data section) has been downloaded.

backends._comment: analysis -> backend mode; providers.py imports scripts/<analysis>_<mode>.py. Omit an analysis (or set it to "remote") to keep today's EBI/Ensembl behavior.

reference_data._comment: paths/URLs for scripts/reference_data.py's bulk downloads (Phase A). out_dir should point at large external storage.

batch_run._comment: scripts/proteome_run.py knobs (Phase C, not yet implemented)
